def QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Run.bind : {α β : Type} → Run α → (α → Run β) → Run β :=
fun {α β} x f =>
  have y := f x.value;
  { value := y.value, cost := x.cost + y.cost }
def QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.collect : {α : Type} → {n : ℕ} → (Fin n → Run α) → Run (Vector α n) :=
fun {α} {n} f =>
  have entries := Vector.ofFn f;
  { value := Vector.map Run.value entries,
    cost := (fun op => ∑ i, entries[↑i].cost op) + n • (2 • tick Op.read + 2 • tick Op.write) }

fun {N M} f => collect fun i => collect (f i)
